title: easyban
description: Simple Cloud Blacklist with No Setup
body:
Most cloud blacklist plugins suffer from these issues:

•  Complicated Audits: Shared blacklists are hard to verify and manage, making them a hassle to use.

•  Limited Coverage: Small databases miss troublemakers, leaving your server vulnerable.

•  Unfair Bans: False positives can kick innocent players, harming your server’s reputation.


EasyBan solves these with a simple, efficient approach:

•  Zero-Config Integration: Seamlessly syncs with Minecraft’s built-in ban system—no setup or auditing required.

•  Automatic Operation: Extracts and uploads ban data from your server automatically, no manual input needed.

•  Tiered Management: Warns for low-risk players and lets you set a custom kick threshold to avoid unfair bans.

Get Started in Three Steps
1.  Download the EasyBan plugin JAR.
2.  Place it in your server’s plugins folder.
3.  Restart your server—it runs automatically!
Optional: Adjust the kick threshold in config.yml (default: 2, any value ≥1).
